# export_plotly_frames_to_mp4 { #mofography.export_mp4.export_plotly_frames_to_mp4 }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> MP4 from Plotly frames API; use when fig.frames is populated. Use `export_staged_figure_to_mp4` instead.

```python
export_mp4.export_plotly_frames_to_mp4(
    fig,
    output_mp4,
    *,
    fps=12,
    width=1280,
    height=720,
    scale=1,
    include_initial=True,
    repeats_per_frame=1,
    crf=20,
    frames_dir=None,
    cleanup_frames=True,
    frame_hook=None,
    kaleido_sync_server=True,
    kaleido_sync_workers=None,
    kaleido_silence_warnings=True,
)
```

Export a figure that uses Plotly's ``frames`` API (slider / animation) to MP4.

Frame patches are applied **cumulatively** in order, matching in-browser animation behavior.



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

include_initial
    If True, the first PNG is the figure's starting state before any ``fig.frames`` patch.
repeats_per_frame
    Duplicate each rendered state this many times (slows motion between keyframes).
kaleido_sync_server, kaleido_sync_workers, kaleido_silence_warnings
    Same meaning as in :func:`export_staged_figure_to_mp4`.
